items.exampleEn: Students must read ten books from the canon of world literature.
items.exampleZh: 學生必須從世界文學經典中讀十本書。

items.exampleEn: Some people believe the lake has supernatural powers.
items.exampleZh: 有些人相信那座湖有超自然的力量。

items.exampleEn: These new stamps commemorate the opening of the bridge.
items.exampleZh: 這套新郵票是紀念大橋通車的。

items.exampleEn: In the video game, your mortal hero can die, so you must play carefully.
items.exampleZh: 在這款電玩裡，你的凡人英雄會死，所以你得小心玩。

items.exampleEn: Many people think it is immoral to lie in advertisements.
items.exampleZh: 很多人認為在廣告裡說謊是不道德的。

items.exampleEn: Some prehistoric animals were bigger than buses.
items.exampleZh: 有些史前動物比公車還大。

items.exampleEn: After living in five countries, she is very worldly.
items.exampleZh: 在五個國家住過之後，她非常見多識廣。

items.exampleEn: Her songs are so famous that many fans call them immortal.
items.exampleZh: 她的歌非常有名，很多歌迷都說它們是不朽的。

items.sentenceEn: Every spring, the town holds a festival to commemorate a famous poet who was born there.
items.sentenceZh: 小鎮每年春天舉辦節慶，紀念一位在當地出生的知名詩人。

items.audioEn: The new film is about a girl with supernatural powers who can talk to animals.
items.audioZh: 這部新電影講一個有超自然力量、能和動物說話的女孩。
items.questionZh: 新電影裡的女孩有什麼能力？

items.sentenceEn: Scientists found prehistoric drawings of horses on the cave walls.
items.sentenceZh: 科學家在洞穴的牆上發現了史前的馬匹圖畫。

items.sentenceEn: Cheating customers is not only illegal but also immoral.
items.sentenceZh: 欺騙顧客不只違法，也不道德。

items.stemEn: In the old story, the hero drinks some magic water and becomes ____, so he can never die.
items.stemZh: 在那個古老的故事裡，英雄喝了一些神奇的水後就長生不死，永遠不會死。

items.stemEn: Her novels are now part of the literary ____ and are taught in many universities.
items.stemZh: 她的小說現在已列入文學經典，許多大學都有教。

items.passageEn: This year, our city museum opened a new exhibition to commemorate its hundredth birthday. The first room shows prehistoric tools found near the river. The next room is about old legends full of supernatural creatures, such as giants and talking trees. In many of these stories, the gods are immortal, while humans are mortal and must accept that life is short. One story tells of a king who became so worldly that he cared only about gold. The gods thought his behavior was immoral and turned his palace into stone. The exhibition has already received a lot of publicity, and it will travel to three other cities next year.
items.passageZh: 今年，我們的市立博物館推出一個新展覽，紀念博物館成立一百週年。第一個展間展出在河邊發現的史前工具。下一個展間介紹充滿超自然生物的古老傳說，例如巨人和會說話的樹。在許多這類故事裡，神長生不死，而人類終有一死，必須接受人生短暫。有一個故事講一位國王變得非常世俗，只在乎金子。眾神認為他的行為不道德，就把他的宮殿變成了石頭。這個展覽已經得到很多宣傳，明年還會到另外三個城市巡迴展出。

questions.questionZh: 故事裡的神為什麼把國王的宮殿變成石頭？

items.promptZh: 他對世俗的成功，例如金錢和名聲，不感興趣。
referenceEn: He is not interested in worldly success, such as money and fame.
He doesn't care about worldly success like money and fame.
rubricZh: worldly 放在名詞前（例如 worldly success、worldly things 等）
「對…不感興趣」可寫，例如 is not interested in、doesn't care about 等
「例如」可寫，例如 such as、like 等

items.instructionZh: 用 supernatural 造一個句子，說說你喜歡或不喜歡的超自然故事、電影或遊戲。
referenceEn: I love films about supernatural creatures like ghosts.
I don't enjoy supernatural stories, because they scare me at night.
rubricZh: supernatural 放在名詞前（例如 supernatural stories、supernatural powers 等）
時態配合內容（例如 love、don't enjoy 等）
